parameters.description: Opaque server-issued visitor cookie used for admission when no decodable customer bearer token is supplied. It is not a customer authentication credential.

post.description:
Anonymous aggregate analytics. With a valid optional customer bearer token, page/search observations are also recorded for that authenticated customer's journey. Customer identifiers and timestamps are never accepted from the payload.

Shared analytics admission over a 15-minute window: 1000 requests per customer or visitor; 4000 per direct connection source in peer mode; 100000 per installation by default. The installation total is configurable with PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_TOTAL_LIMIT. Ingress mode delegates source throttling to trusted ingress; subject and installation limits remain shared in PostgreSQL across replicas. A customer bearer identity is used when present and decodable; otherwise the opaque analytics_visitor cookie identifies the visitor. This admission identity grants no access: the endpoint still enforces its own authentication and live-session checks. Retain server-issued cookies for this installation; changing cookies does not bypass source or installation limits.

parameters.description: Opaque server-issued visitor cookie used for admission when no decodable customer bearer token is supplied. It is not a customer authentication credential.

get.description: Shared memory admission over a 15-minute window: 120 requests per customer or visitor; 600 per direct connection source in peer mode; 12000 per installation by default. The installation total is configurable with PUBLIC_MEMORY_TOTAL_LIMIT. Ingress mode delegates source throttling to trusted ingress; subject and installation limits remain shared in PostgreSQL across replicas. A customer bearer identity is used when present and decodable; otherwise the opaque assistant_visitor cookie identifies the visitor. This admission identity grants no access: the endpoint still enforces its own authentication and live-session checks. Retain server-issued cookies for this installation; changing cookies does not bypass source or installation limits.
